CustomField.description: 2020-12-17 Case 60238 changes for integrated new/extension approvals. 2021-02-24 Missing Opp Reg Owner Levels causes Approval Assignment to be blank INC0123192
CustomField.formula: IF(Opp_Reg_Approval_Assignment__c = 0, "Please contact Channel Ops, Deal Registration Approval Assignment is missing. ","") & IF(ISBLANK(Account__c), "End Customer Account is blank. ","") & IF(ISPICKVAL(or_Opp_Reg_Status__c,"Pending"),"","Status must be Pending or Extension Pending. ")& IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(or_Opp_Reg_Status__c,"Pending"),Opp_Reg_Extension_Count__c<>0),"Extension Count must be 0 for new Deal Registration approval. ","")& IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(or_Opp_Reg_Status__c,"Pending"),or_New_Opp_Reg__c=FALSE),"New Deal Reg? must be selected for new Deal Registration approval. ","")& IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(or_Opp_Reg_Status__c,"Pending"),NOT(ISPICKVAL(or_Opp_Reg_Approval_Flow_Status__c,"Approvals not started"))),"Approval Flow Status must be 'Approvals not started.' ","")& IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(or_Opp_Reg_Status__c,"Pending"),or_Create_Opportunity_upon_Approval__c=FALSE,ISBLANK(Mapped_Opportunity__c)),"Enter a Mapped Opportunity or select Create Opportunity Upon Approval.","") & IF(OR(ISPICKVAL(Mapped_Opportunity__r.StageName,"Closed Won"),ISPICKVAL(Mapped_Opportunity__r.StageName,"Failed"), ISPICKVAL(Mapped_Opportunity__r.StageName,"Failed Renewal")), "Map an open oppty to submit for approval. ", "")
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Field needs to be blank to Submit for Approval
CustomField.label: Missing for Approval
